verdict.rationale: Solid's components are plain JavaScript functions that run once to set up their view. Developers declare reactive state that only re-runs dependent code, and compose components with JSX, fragments, Context, Stores and Portals. Hands-on reports confirm it works in practice: one user ported react-bootstrap painlessly and another used Solid on a largish product for over a year. A complaint that props must be functions to stay reactive is friction, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of component-scoped local state (e.g. signals declared inside a component) and of props/children composition patterns.
